sloka: एहि इति उच्छैः हरि वरान् सुग्रीवः समुदाहरत् ।तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा हरयः शीघ्रम् आययुः ॥४-३८-७॥
transliteration: ehi iti ucchaiḥ hari varān sugrīvaḥ samudāharat ।tasya tad vacanam śrutvā harayaḥ śīghram āyayuḥ ॥4-38-7॥

translations.english: Sugriva called in the monkeys who deserved audience of the female folk of the royal family. They came forward quickly with folded hands welcoming the heroes.
